name: Relic plate
description: The ground a ruins find is shown on: a rim, a dark panel, and an old light bleeding out of the middle. Every find composes this via `use`, so the twenty-odd of them share one definition and the plate can be lifted off in one line — the `glyph` variant each of them declares removes this part and nothing else, which is what an unmet collection entry shows. The `curse` variant swaps gold for arcane, the two colours the ruins outcome already switches between.

curse.description: What the ruins hand you when the trespass is answered instead of rewarded. Same plate, arcane light.
